title: Verify: Lifecycle stepper renders each stage unit tests
summary: Tests for every stage state and execution panel fields
description: Pure component unit tests, no fetch needed.
acceptance_criteria: Each of seven statuses marks one current
DEVELOPING marks earlier done and later pending

steps.action: Export executionFixture shaped like Execution in backend/internal/execution/execution.go (id,world_id,round_id,status,error,updated_at json keys)

Tests: it.each over the seven STAGES renders LifecycleStepper status=stage and asserts exactly one li has aria-current 'step' with that text; status 'DEVELOPING' asserts OPEN..ANALYZING data-state done and TESTING..COMPLETED pending; status 'BUILDING' marks TESTING current; ExecutionPanel with executionFixture error 'build failed' shows 'Failure reason: build failed'; without log/tests/release fields shows 'Not available' three times; contributionCount 3 shows 'Contributions: 3'
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/stepper.test.tsx
